name: Anchor Offline Notes (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted offline-first notes application with web/mobile sync, tags, attachments, reminders, sharing, note history, and Google Keep import; no vendor-imposed software license quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker host and persistent storage; hosting and network costs are separate. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply to modified network-served versions; iOS app distribution is currently TestFlight beta, and real-time collaborative editing is not yet implemented.
